title: Country Climate and Development Report: Benin
temporal_coverage: EHCVM household survey 2018/19; climate projections including 2070
methodology: CCDR analysis with EHCVM 2018/19 household shock estimates.
limitations: EHCVM shocks are self-reported retrospectively; fragility passage gives no causal estimate.

title: Benin Economic Update 2024: Adapting to climate change for sustainable, resilient economic growth
temporal_coverage: Economic-loss projection through 2050; adaptation priorities for coming decades
methodology: World Bank publisher summary of the 2024 Economic Update; projected losses are reported as estimates.
limitations: The inspected summary does not state the model assumptions or climate scenario behind the GDP estimate.

title: Troisième Contribution Déterminée au niveau National du Bénin (CDN 3.0)
geographic_coverage: Coastal zone and five seafront communes
temporal_coverage: Agricultural statistics through 2025; climate risks and planned adaptation measures in NDC 3.0
methodology: Government NDC submission describing sectoral climate vulnerabilities, exposure and planned projects.
limitations: Project listings are commitments, not evidence of implementation or effectiveness; coastal erosion rates apply to critical locations.
